title: 0001 狱卒0002 镇妖殿
content_zh:
山河形胜之地，外有百二关河环绕以为屏障，内有八水穿流滋养王气。烽燧立于四野，驿道通达八方，控扼天下咽喉，乃定鼎九州之枢。
街巷纵横如棋盘，市列珠玑，户盈罗绮。九重城阙如天上宫阙落入凡尘，万间宫宇鳞次栉比金碧辉映直插云霄。御道宽逾百步，直通大内禁宫，宛若天河，好一幅帝王都城盛景。
“唉……日光之下无新事！”站在高高的望楼顶层，极目远眺如此一座巨大城市，洪涛却在哀叹其似曾相识又倍感陌生。
穿越过来已经五天了，始终待在暗无天日的地牢之中，直到今天才得以休憩。可爬到了目之所及的最高点放眼望去，再联系这几日所见所闻，心中困惑不光未解还添了更多。
这辈子他还叫洪涛，身材相貌也没什么变化。可以确定是在古代，按照相貌和语言区分也该是中华大地。
然而现在的国号为大夏，皇帝姓杨，所处之地为京师，全国分成了一京十五路，使用的货币是白银……一切状况和历史所有朝代都对不上，这让以善于观察分析的洪涛苦恼不已。
更麻烦的是这里的人居然会超能力，可以通过修炼提高自身状态，并能用法术和符箓影响其他人甚至大自然。不是道听途说，而是亲眼所见。
但这还不是最烧脑的，亲眼看到妖魔鬼怪，且几乎天天接触，还要亲手给它们上刑折磨逼供，简直太匪夷所思了。让自己这个坚定的无神论者三观直接崩溃，随之就是瑟瑟发抖和满满的绝望。
如果穿越到古代，无论中外，自己都可以凭借历史知识和现代知识逢凶化吉高歌猛进，不光不会受罪还能予取予夺。
哪怕到了原始时代，也可以利用现有条件制造各种工具成为部落第一勇士甚至首领大祭司什么的，带着同族直奔小康。
可翻遍了每条脑回路，也找不到丝毫有关修炼法术的积累，甚至连中国古代神仙谱系都凑不全。直接从先知变成了二傻子，别说当人上人了，能不能融入社会都是问题。
万一这个时代的法术能看透自己所想，或者算出自己的来历，那就连小白鼠都当不成了。
这几天亲眼所见被符箓打散魂魄彻底消亡的妖魔鬼怪就有好几位，到时候自己肯定也得把全套酷刑都尝一遍，然后被从**到灵魂轰的粉碎，渣儿都不剩一点。
自杀？除非现在马上死，否则等被那些有法力的修士们发现，真就叫天天不应叫地地不灵了，想死都是奢望。
如果没有这份很特别的工作，洪涛在大致搞清楚状况之后肯定早就找个不太痛苦的方式把自己弄死了。
这辈子的工作单位是镇妖殿西殿诏狱，不属于朝廷任何一个部门，由皇帝委派亲信直接统领。专门负责在全国范围内捉妖伏魔、缉捕犯禁修士，有点类似中国古代的锦衣卫以及后世的安全部。
担任的具体职务叫行刑力士，为无品胥吏。工作内容特别血腥残酷，对关押在这里的案犯严刑拷打逼供，包括秘密处死，外带毁尸灭迹！
原本生活在这个时代的洪涛是从父辈儿开始做行刑力士的，16岁顶替父亲进入诏狱当杂役，兢兢业业勤勤恳恳任劳任怨10年才混到行刑力士，一干又是14年。
要说被夺舍的洪涛身子骨还是不错的，生得高高大大，从小习武打熬气力，升任行刑力士之后还成了修士，普通人三五个近不得身。
可能是干工作太认真太投入，得了职业病，精神上受到强烈刺激有点不正常。大致上是得了忧郁症，病情越来越重，最终想不开就在诏狱里上了吊。

正是趁着他的灵魂弥留之际，自己的灵魂才轻易夺舍了其肉身的控制权。好在绳扣系得不够专业，否则就是穿越最快的一辈子了，刚过来没几分钟还得走。
缓过来之后，按照习惯开始探索周边环境。牢房肯定是一眼就认出来了，而能在牢房里自由活动的肯定不是犯人，那就是狱卒呗。
对于这份工作洪涛还是不反对的，监狱环境相对封闭，往来人员不太复杂，更利于慢慢熟悉融入新生。至于说精神方面的刺激，对于重生穿越了n多次，啥场面都见过、啥危险都经历过的自己来讲真不算啥。
天天看着案犯们受刑的惨状，听着它们鬼哭狼嚎，并不会对自己产生半分影响。当年带兵打仗时伤兵满营、尸横遍野的状况更惨，坐在死人堆旁边吃饭也毫不动容，早就习惯了。
然而一位大和尚的到来，比见到行刑场面还恐怕。他在进入地牢之后口中念念有词，然后浑身居然开始发光，惨白惨白的。被这些光芒笼罩之后，内心无来由的安宁平静起来，至少另一个洪涛的灵魂是这种反应。
没有电，没有灯泡，也没有化学物质的异味儿，和尚是靠什么发的光呢？通过阅读另一个灵魂的记忆，洪涛找到了答案，然后就更懵逼了。
法术，居然是传说中的法术！这名年纪不太大的和尚法号云安，是京城护国寺西堂班首。其佛法精纯，每个月都会来镇妖殿诏狱施法，为在这里工作的皂吏和品级低下的修士祛除邪祟侵扰。
从这一点上也能看出此地的工作性质还是比较危险的，每天和妖魔鬼怪同处一室，即便它们已经被法术和法器封印，无法施法害人，仍旧会对人的心理产生很大影响。
就像被自己夺舍了身体的洪涛，正是由于见到太多残酷血腥场面，才被毫不知情的影响到了精神，结果居然起了自杀念头。而这种事情在诏狱里不是个例，否则也不会让云安和尚定期来施法安抚。
从效果上看，云安和尚的法术只能缓解却无法治愈心理疾病。或者是他学艺不精，如果换主持和方丈来说不定就能去病根了。
送走了和尚，地牢里重新被阴森森的气氛所笼罩，众人全都散去各忙各的。洪涛闲着没事儿索性把一层的二十多间牢房全参观了一遍，再对照案牍一一核实。
发现这里关押的案犯多半是官员，少半是刑事犯罪。只有2名修士被铁链锁住四肢，铁钩穿刺琵琶骨，后颈还插着两根细长银针。
这东西叫锁魂针，专门破坏修行者的识海，不管有多大修为也会立马变成凡人，半点法力都施展不出来了。
但这并不是诏狱的全部，东边和南边还有两个类似的地牢，加在一起形成天地人三个区域。自己所在的人字区牢房是级别最低的，隶属诏狱的工作人员都可以进出，关押的全是下品修士和同等妖魔。
地字区牢房就需要特殊腰牌或者当值校尉带领才能进入了，里面关押的全是中品修士和妖魔。南边的天字区牢房级别最高，专门用来关押上品修士和妖魔。
洪涛做为在这里工作了二十多年的行刑力士，虽然不入品却可以随意通行。因为每层地牢通道最里面的房间都是刑房，等于行刑力士的工作间。
三处地牢的格局基本一样，全是由巨石垒砌的墙壁，钢铁打造的栅栏，昏暗的油灯光芒，淡淡的潮湿气味和冷飕飕的体感。没有血腥、恶臭、发霉之类的味道，也没有吵吵闹闹喊冤和呻吟声不断。
牢房里打扫的非常干净，杂役们每天早中晚清洁三次。当年洪涛刚入诏狱时干的就是这个工作，足足当了5年保洁才混到值班力士资格，就是每天分三班在地牢里溜达，关注在押犯的一举一动。
content_en:
It is a beautiful place with mountains and rivers, surrounded by hundreds of rivers outside as a barrier, and eight waters flowing through it inside to nourish the king's energy. The beacon towers stand in all directions, and the post roads reach all directions, controlling the throat of the world. They are the hub of the Jiuzhou.
The streets and alleys are like a chessboard, the streets are lined with pearls, and the households are filled with flowers. The nine-layered city is like a palace in the sky falling into the mortal world, and thousands of palaces are lined with gold and jade, shining directly into the sky. The royal road is more than a hundred paces wide and leads directly to the Great Inner Forbidden Palace. It looks like the Milky Way, creating a magnificent view of the imperial capital.
"Alas...there is nothing new under the sun!" Standing on the top floor of a tall watchtower, overlooking such a huge city, Hong Tao lamented that it seemed familiar yet strange.
It has been five days since I traveled back in time, and I have been staying in a dark dungeon until today. But when I climbed to the highest point and looked around, combined with what I had seen and heard in the past few days, I felt not only unsolved but also more confused.
In this life, his name is still Hong Tao, and his body and appearance have not changed much. It can be determined that it was in ancient times. According to appearance and language, it should be the land of China.
However, the current name of the country is Daxia, the emperor's surname is Yang, the location is the capital, the country is divided into one capital and fifteen roads, and the currency used is silver... All the conditions are not consistent with all dynasties in history, which makes Hong Tao, who is good at observation and analysis, troubled.
What's even more troublesome is that the people here actually have superpowers. They can improve their own status through practice, and can use spells and talismans to influence other people and even nature. Not by hearsay, but by seeing it with my own eyes.
But that's not the most brain-burning thing. Seeing demons and monsters with your own eyes, coming into contact with them almost every day, and having to torture them with your own hands to extract confessions is simply unbelievable. This made my staunch atheist view collapse directly, followed by trembling and despair.
If you travel back in time to ancient times, no matter at home or abroad, you can rely on historical knowledge and modern knowledge to turn danger into good fortune and make great progress. Not only will you not suffer, but you can also take and take away.
Even in primitive times, you can use existing conditions to make various tools to become the first warrior or even the leader of the tribe, the high priest, etc., and lead your fellow tribesmen straight to a well-off society.
But after rummaging through every circuit in his brain, he couldn't find any accumulation of magic skills. He couldn't even find a complete genealogy of ancient Chinese gods. From a prophet to a fool, let alone becoming a master, whether he can integrate into society is a problem.
If the magic of this era could see through one's own thoughts, or figure out one's origins, then he wouldn't even be a guinea pig.
In the past few days, I have seen with my own eyes several demons and monsters whose souls were broken up by talismans and completely destroyed. When the time comes, I will definitely have to taste the full set of tortures, and then they will be smashed from body to soul, leaving no trace of scum left.
suicide? Unless he died immediately, otherwise when the monks with magical powers discovered him, the whole world would be in ruins, and death would be a luxury.
Without this very special job, Hong Tao would have definitely found a less painful way to kill himself after roughly understanding the situation.
The work unit in this life is the Imperial Prison in the West Hall of the Demon Suppression Hall. It does not belong to any department of the imperial court and is directly led by the emperor's trusted aides. It is responsible for catching demons and demons and arresting criminals and monks across the country. It is somewhat similar to the Jin Yiwei in ancient China and the Ministry of Security in later generations.
The specific position he held was called executioner, a subordinate official with no rank. The work content is particularly bloody and cruel. The criminals detained here are tortured to extract confessions, including secret executions and the destruction of corpses to remove traces!
Hong Tao, who originally lived in this era, started to be an executioner from his father's generation. At the age of 16, he replaced his father and entered the imperial prison as a handyman. He worked diligently and hard for 10 years before he became an executioner, and he worked for another 14 years.
Hong Tao, who was taken away from his body, has a good body. He was born tall and strong. He practiced martial arts since he was a child to build up his strength. After being promoted to an execution warrior, he became a monk. An ordinary person.Three or five people can't get close enough.
It may be that I was too serious and devoted to my work, contracted an occupational disease, and was mentally stimulated, which was a bit abnormal. Basically, he suffered from depression, and his condition became worse and worse. In the end, he couldn't think of anything and hung himself in prison.
It was while his soul was dying that his own soul easily took over control of his body. Fortunately, the rope buckle was not fastened professionally, otherwise it would have been the fastest time in my life, and I would have to leave within a few minutes of coming here.
After calming down, start exploring the surrounding environment as usual. The cell must be recognizable at a glance, and the person who can move freely in the cell is definitely not the prisoner, but the jailer.
Hong Tao still has no objection to this job. The prison environment is relatively closed and the people coming and going are not too complicated, which is more conducive to gradually getting familiar with the new students. As for the mental stimulation, it is nothing to me who has been reborn and traveled through n times, seen every scene, and experienced every danger.
Watching the miserable torture of the criminals every day and listening to their cries and howls would not have any impact on me. When he led troops to fight in the past, the situation was even worse when the camp was full of wounded soldiers and corpses were strewn across the fields. He didn't show any emotion when he sat next to a pile of dead people to eat. He had long been used to it.
However, the arrival of a great monk was more terrifying than seeing the execution scene. After entering the dungeon, he muttered something, and then his whole body started to glow, turning pale and pale. After being shrouded in these lights, my heart felt peaceful and calm for no reason. At least this was the reaction of the other Hong Tao's soul.
There is no electricity, no light bulbs, and no smell of chemicals. How does the monk generate light? By reading the memory of another soul, Hong Tao found the answer, and then became even more confused.
The spell is actually a legendary spell! This young monk, whose Buddhist name is Yun'an, is the leader of the West Hall of Huguo Temple in the capital. His Buddhist Dharma is pure, and he comes to the Demon Suppressing Hall every month to perform spells in order to get rid of evil spirits and evil spirits for the officials and low-level monks who work here.
From this point, it can also be seen that the nature of the work here is quite dangerous. Being in the same room with monsters and ghosts every day, even if they have been sealed by spells and magical weapons and cannot cast spells to harm people, will still have a great impact on people's psychology.
Just like Hong Tao, whose body was taken away by him, it was precisely because he saw too many cruel and bloody scenes that his spirit was unknowingly affected, and he actually had suicidal thoughts. And this kind of thing is not an exception in the imperial prison, otherwise monk Yun'an would not be allowed to come to cast spells regularly to appease him.
From an effect point of view, Monk Yun'an's spell can only alleviate but cannot cure mental illness. Or maybe he is not good at studying. If the host and abbot are changed, the root cause of the disease may be eliminated.
After sending the monk away, the dungeon was once again enveloped in a gloomy atmosphere, and everyone dispersed and went about their own business. Hong Tao had nothing to do, so he visited all the more than 20 cells on the first floor and checked them one by one against the documents.
It was found that most of the criminals detained here were officials, and less than half were criminal offenders. Only two monks had their limbs locked with iron chains, with iron hooks piercing their bones, and two slender silver needles stuck in the back of their necks.
This thing is called the soul-locking needle, which is designed to destroy the sea of ​​consciousness of a practitioner. No matter how advanced he is, he will immediately become a mortal, unable to use any magic power.
But this is not all of the prison. There are two similar dungeons on the east and south sides, which together form three areas of heaven, earth and people. The cell in the herringbone area where he is located is the lowest level and can be entered and exited by staff members affiliated with the prison. All the prisoners are low-grade monks and demons of the same level.
The cells in the Dizi area require special waistbands or the leadership of the captain on duty to enter. The cells in them are all middle-grade monks and demons. The cells in Tianzi District in the south are the highest level and are specially used to imprison high-grade monks and demons.
As an executioner who has worked here for more than 20 years, Hong Tao can pass freely despite being unqualified. Because each layerThe innermost room in the dungeon passage is the execution room, which is equivalent to the executioner's workshop.
The layout of the three dungeons is basically the same, with walls made of boulders, fences made of steel, dim light from oil lamps, a faint smell of moisture and a chilly feeling. There is no smell of blood, stench, or mold, and there are no noisy shouts of grievances or constant groans.
The cell was kept very clean, with the handymen cleaning it three times every morning, noon and evening. This was the job Hong Tao did when he first entered the imperial prison. He worked as a cleaner for five years before he was qualified as a guard on duty. He walked around the dungeon in three shifts every day and paid attention to every move of the prisoners.
